evidence.title: BoardUI: React Design System for Agent UIs & Dashboards

name: BoardUI
summary: React design system of 48 free components and blocks for AI agent UIs and dashboards, installed by CLI or MCP.
description: BoardUI ships editable React and Tailwind source for agent and dashboard interfaces: base form and data components, agent blocks (thinking, progress, composer, questionnaire, task list, web search), dashboard blocks (data table, stat cards, sidebar, auth, notifications, settings) and chart blocks, over 400 semantic tokens with dark mode. Items install through the BoardUI CLI or its MCP server, a shadcn registry namespace is supported, and a free Next.js chat starter with a server-side streaming route ships with it; pro components and templates are paid.
contains: 48 free components and blocks under the MIT license, plus pro components and templates
agent UI blocks: thinking states, progress, composer, questionnaire, task list, web search
dashboard UI: data table, stat cards, sidebar, notifications, auth, settings
12 chart types incl. area, funnel, heatmap, radar, sankey, scatter, steps
400+ semantic tokens for color, typography, dark mode, radii, shadows
free Next.js chat starter with server-side streaming route and model keys
installs via BoardUI CLI, npm dependencies, MCP server or @boardui registry namespace
